prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a totally ORIGINAL miniature architectural 3D diorama panorama, wide landscape aspect ratio about 1.7:1, continuous across three equal vertical slices, for a sophisticated app-store campaign. Palette pale aqua, saturated turquoise, lilac-blue, white plaster, coral red accent. Three connected floating architectural islands sit in shallow clear blue water in the LOWER 65 percent of the canvas, connected by graceful white bridges. LEFT island: rounded white modern pavilion, a coral curved staircase and a tiny turquoise pool. MIDDLE island: tall white sculptural arch, tiered pale blue stairs, a coral circular balcony. RIGHT island: white airy stepped amphitheatre, turquoise arches, a tiny bright cobalt pavilion. The islands are architectural and abstract, no gardens, no trees, no forest, no literal planets, no books. Premium architectural scale model, convincing porcelain plaster, soft realistic sunlight, exquisite miniature shadows, beautiful clear water reflections. Upper 30 percent is mostly uniform quiet pale-aqua sky, leaving calm room for large headings. Leave broad openings in the architecture where real app screenshots can be composited later. No phone or electronics, no interface, no people, no text, no numbers, no logos, no border, no watermark, no fantasy castle, no glossy candy characters. Render ONE coherent wide full-bleed scene, not three separate pictures or panels. The scene should feel uplifting, intelligent, airy and magical through design rather than mysticism.
